observations: Spread hand used nine buckets, with only sixty-four and seventy sharing one, requiring one comparison.
Switching to the clumped preset automatically demonstrated dropping and sorting all ten values into bucket forty-one to fifty.
Clumped sort reported thirty comparisons with per-value counts and the sum 1+1+3+3+2+6+3+6+5.
Screenshot shows one tall sorted stack with individual comparison labels; reveal explains distribution dependence and reduction to the inner sort.
